hard_deny: Never run pkill, killall, or any other command that selects processes by matching a pattern against their command lines. This selects by text, so it reaches processes belonging to the user and to other tools, not only the ones the agent started. Terminating a process is acceptable only when it is addressed by an explicit PID captured earlier in the same session, or through TaskStop for a background task the agent started itself. No stated reason clears this.
